text:
rafael: heads-up for march close - marketplace partner MarketLink GmbH sent a retro rate adjustment affecting March settlements. invoice (credit note) arrived 2025-04-07 for EUR 28,750 referencing contract ML-PLAT-2019. do we reduce revenue, adjust COGS, or set up a deferral?
claire: quick Q: is the adjustment a reduction of vendor payout (we net to vendor) or did they ask for cash refund? need the document. also paste the original settlement line for March.
samir: pasted snippet below. looks like a retro rate change because of volume tiering - they recalculated share for Mar.
```
Credit Note: CN-ML-2025-009
Related Settlement: ML-SETTLE-2025-03
Service period: 2025-03-01 to 2025-03-31
Credit date: 2025-04-07
Amount: EUR 28,750 (VAT excl)
Contract: ML-PLAT-2019 (section 4.2 tiered revenue share recalculation)
Vendor stated FX: 1.10 USD/EUR
```
nina: revrec POV: since we bill customers gross and recognize revenue in March, the vendor adjustment that relates to March activity should flow to COGS (reduce vendor payout) rather than change revenue. So treat as COGS credit in March.
rafael: we had an accrual for vendor payouts for March (JE# 2025-03-1188). Should we reverse part of that accrual instead of booking a new credit?
claire: check AP: JE 1188 accrual was USD 410,500. The EUR28,750 converts to USD using month-end spot per policy (2025-03-31 spot = 1.12). 28,750 * 1.12 = USD 32,200. We'll reduce the accrual by USD 32,200 and credit Hosting COGS.
samir: agree. also include mapping showing which customer settlements were impacted so auditors can trace. i'll prepare the mapping.
nina: GL entries: Debit Accrued Liabilities (2118) USD32,200; Credit Hosting COGS (6012) USD32,200. Add memo: "MarketLink retro rate adjustment related to Mar2025 settlements; spot FX 2025-03-31 = 1.12; reversal of accrual JE#2025-03-1188"
rafael: approval path: i can approve up to 50k; this is 32,200 so fine. i'll approve once JE draft is in binder.
rev-bot: Month-end binder updated: new file uploaded by samir (ML_Mar2025_rate_adj_mapping.xlsx). :white_check_mark:
samir: JE draft posted: JE_2025-03_CR_MarketLink.xlsx. tagging @rafael for approval. included both invoice credit note PDF and contract clause screenshot.
rafael: reviewed, approve. posting JE now. please include a 1-line note in close memo explaining why revenue unchanged and cost adjusted. auditors asked to see original settlement and recalculation.
claire: added close memo note and included sample customer settlement detail. saved as close_memo_Mar2025_marketlink.txt in binder.
samir: JE posted to GL (JE# 2025-03-1333). reversal template for April saved to binder in case vendor nets future invoices.
rev-bot: Reminder: "Audit package updated: files added by samir (ML_Mar2025_rate_adj_mapping.xlsx, JE_2025-03_CR_MarketLink.xlsx, close_memo_Mar2025_marketlink.txt)" :white_check_mark:
rafael: thanks all. action items: samir to keep mapping for auditors; claire to keep contract clause screenshot; nina to note FX treatment in the close pack. Thread resolved for month-end. :heavy_check_mark:
